task_description: Summarize each dataset row into one sentence in the same language as the input. Platform feeds each CSV/JSONL row as outer_context (fields input and task; score against expected).

steps.title: Draft summary
steps.aim: Capture the main idea of the source text as a single rough sentence
steps.stage_action: Read the source text from the Data section (fields input or task). Write one sentence that states the central fact. Use the same language as the input. Ignore minor details.
steps.reasoning_questions: What is the single most important message? How to say it in one sentence?

steps.title: Polish final sentence
steps.aim: Deliver one grammatically correct final summary sentence
steps.stage_action: Using the draft from the previous step and the original Data section, output exactly one polished sentence. Same language as the input. No markdown, no quotes, no labels, no preamble.
steps.reasoning_questions: Is the draft faithful to the source? Can wording be shorter or clearer without losing meaning?
